summary: Factored the shared maximum-order inference: strict causal ascent excludes a distinct cause of a maximal member. Homogeneous Fourth Way instances for being/goodness/truth and attribution pullback compose the existing #386 Mathlib representation lemmas. The reverse inference that a maximum causes all others is rejected by an ordered Bool model with no causal edges; dropping ascent allows a lower cause of the maximum. Universal possession and unrestricted cause-more-such remain conditional hypotheses; secondary-cause failures in the existing attribution result remain intact. No source reading, maximum existence, uniqueness, identity with God or root closure follows.
